classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Owns a Group's relative placement hints and observes native movement without recording
 * requested geometry as an outcome.
 * @description Documents remain independent participants. This participant contains only keyed
 * relative offsets and semantic fallback targets; window routes, rectangles and pending effects
 * stay on this live owner. A free popup move appends after quiescence. A main-frame move rebases
 * current hints through a preserve write, leaving history and the redo tail intact.
 * @class Neo.dashboard.dock.window.Placement
 * @extends Neo.core.Base
 */

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Re-targets each fallback whose node the current documents no longer hold.
     * @description A document-only write never prepares this participant, so a fallback captured
     * against main's root can outlive that node (a root-edge wrap, a reset), and the persistence
     * boundary refuses a hint naming a missing node. Such a fallback resolves to its workspace's
     * current root. One whose node still exists is kept as stored, so undoing the document change
     * restores the original target.
     * @param {Object} hints
     * @param {Object<String,Object>} documents
     * @returns {Object} The same hints object when no fallback is stale.
     * @static
     */
classData.summary: Re-targets each fallback whose node the current documents no longer hold.

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Resolves the outer size a torn-out vessel opens at: the dragged pane's rendered size
     * by default (a tab header's drag proxy is no measure of the widget), a host-pinned size when
     * the product wants one, clamped to the screen's usable area and to the platform's popup floor.
     * Without a source or a pin the fallback applies. All sizes are outer window pixels: the window's
     * frame takes over the pane's footprint on screen, and its content is smaller by the window
     * chrome on purpose, so no chrome is added anywhere.
     * @param {Object} [request={}]
     * @param {Object} [request.fallback={width: 480, height: 360}] The size without a source or a pin.
     * @param {Object} [request.floor={width: 320, height: 240}] The platform's popup minimum.
     * @param {Object|null} [request.pinned] A host-pinned `{width, height}`.
     * @param {Object|null} [request.screen] `{availWidth, availHeight}` of the current screen.
     * @param {Object|null} [request.sourceRect] The dragged pane's rendered rect, measured before it left.
     * @returns {{height: Number, width: Number}}
     * @static
     */
